title: UN Special Rapporteur: Israeli Checkpoints Fragment Palestinian Territory
detail: UN Special Rapporteur says Israeli checkpoints fragment Palestinian territory and worsen living conditions, restricting movement across the West Bank and undermining the viability of a future Palestinian state.

title: Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir Threatens Mass Displacement of Palestinians
detail: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben-Gvir threatens mass displacement of Palestinians and calls for freer use of lethal force, declaring 'The Entire Land is Ours' in inflammatory remarks escalating settler movement rhetoric.

title: Israel Demolishes West Bank Olive Groves as Settlers Block Harvest
detail: Israeli forces demolish West Bank olive groves as settlers continue to block Palestinian olive harvest in Area B, deepening economic harm to Palestinian farmers ahead of the annual harvest season.

title: Al Jazeera Investigates Mystery Co-Pilot Behind Flydubai Attack on Israel-Bound Flight
detail: Al Jazeera investigates the identity of the mystery co-pilot allegedly behind the Flydubai attack on an Israel-bound flight, raising questions about the perpetrators and regional aviation security implications.

media.caption: Investigation into the identity of the mystery co-pilot behind the Flydubai attack

title: Israeli Forces Hold Palestinian Activist Issa Amro Incommunicado
detail: Israeli forces held prominent Palestinian activist and Hebron-based rights defender Issa Amro incommunicado for several hours, according to an Israeli rights lawyer, marking another incident of detention of civil society figures.
